name: peoplesearch-im
description: Find professionals by describing them in plain English, open their LinkedIn profiles and get their verified work emails.

interface.longDescription:
PeopleSearch.im gives ChatGPT a database of professional profiles. Describe the people you need in plain English, such as "heads of growth at SaaS companies in New York" or "recruiters at stripe.com in Dublin", and ChatGPT finds the professionals who match, opens the profiles you choose (name, current title, company, location and LinkedIn URL) and looks up their verified work email addresses, without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Prospect and build lead lists: search by role, seniority, company or website, industry, company size and location, then unlock the people you want.
- Source candidates: search by job title, experience and place, and get each candidate's profile and contact details.
- Find and verify work emails: get a person's work email from their name and company or from their LinkedIn profile URL, check whether an address will deliver before you send, or find the contact addresses at a company domain.
- Research people and companies: turn a name and company into a LinkedIn profile, look up a LinkedIn profile or company page, or find the person behind a work email.

How it works: searching people and companies shows how many professionals match and a preview of each, without your account. Opening a profile or running a lookup uses credits from your PeopleSearch.im account; lookups that find nothing give their credits back. The first time ChatGPT needs your account, you sign in or create one and approve access, and you can disconnect at any time from the Developers page on peoplesearch.im.

Who it is for: salespeople, recruiters, founders and researchers who need to reach specific professionals.

Limitations: results come from a B2B people-data provider, so very new roles or small companies may be missing; not every person has a findable work email. PeopleSearch.im returns business information and work email addresses only, never personal phone numbers, home addresses or personal email addresses, and it cannot send messages or post anywhere. Anyone can remove their profile at peoplesearch.im/opt-out.
capabilities: Find B2B leads and sales prospects
Search professionals by role, company and place
Find verified work emails and contact info
defaultPrompt: Find heads of growth at SaaS companies in New York
Find the work email of a person from their LinkedIn profile
Who are the recruiters at stripe.com in Dublin?

positive.description: Search for professionals described in plain English, without spending credits
positive.prompt: Find heads of growth at SaaS companies in New York.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports how many people match (260 on 2026-10-31) and lists a few masked previews with title, industry and location. No credit is spent.

positive.description: Open one person from a search, with their verified work email
positive.prompt: Show me the first person from that search, with their work email.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the person's full name, current title, company, location, LinkedIn URL and verified work email (or says none was found and the credit was refunded), followed by the credits left.

positive.description: Find a person's work email from their name and company
positive.prompt: What is the work email of Satya Nadella at Microsoft?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns satya@microsoft.com with its confidence label and his LinkedIn URL.

positive.description: Find the work email behind a LinkedIn profile URL
positive.prompt: Find the work email for https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeffweiner08
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Jeff Weiner's current role and company (Next Play Ventures) and his verified work email.

positive.description: Check whether an email address will deliver
positive.prompt: Is support@stripe.com a deliverable email address?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers that the address is deliverable, with the confidence of the check.

negative.description: Sending messages is not supported: the plugin only finds people and checks emails, it cannot send email or messages.
negative.prompt: Email the people you found and invite them to a demo.

negative.description: Personal contact data is not provided: the plugin returns professional profiles and work emails only, never home addresses, personal phone numbers or personal email addresses.
negative.prompt: Find the home address and personal phone number of Satya Nadella.

negative.description: Account management is outside the plugin: closing an account is done through the support page, so no tool should run.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold inside ChatGPT. Opening profiles and running lookups spend credits the user already holds in their PeopleSearch.im account, bought on peoplesearch.im. When the account has none, the plugin says so and links the informational pricing page.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: the listing now names the jobs the plugin does: finding B2B leads and prospects, sourcing candidates for recruiters, and finding work emails and contact info. No change to tools or behavior.
